restarting_detail: This usually takes a few seconds. Apps disconnect briefly and reconnect on their own.
slow_detail: It's been 90 seconds. Check the logs on the hub machine: journalctl --user -u personad for the background service (it keeps its old name), docker compose logs hub for Docker.
restart_manual: {reasons}. Restart on the hub machine: systemctl --user restart personad, or docker compose restart hub.
restart_confirm_body: The hub exits and systemd or Docker starts it again right away. Phones and the web disconnect for a few seconds; running agents aren't affected (they run on their own computers).
